reviewBasis: Claude static-code review supplied by owner after Checkpoint 02

items.finding: New perspective record IDs can stale unchanged references/comparisons
items.before: Freshness coupled to complete view objects/record identity
items.rule: Historical IDs are provenance. Freshness compares semantic values relevant to the region.
tests: Changing only head perspective does not retire an unchanged arm reference
Changing relevant body perspective still retires an arm reference
Comparison freshness ignores replacement record IDs when semantics are unchanged

items.finding: Older backup can fork solely because current schema adds empty Knowledge fields
items.rule: Normalize current and incoming records into the current non-destructive shape before duplicate/revision comparison.
tests: Old CP01 backup upgrades and reimports without clip/reference/comparison forks

items.finding: Sparse one-anchor pose can rank as perfect
items.rule: Require >=2 shared visible informative points beyond the normalization anchor for a numeric knowledge score.
tests: Sparse pose signature refuses a one-anchor perfect match

items.finding: Prior head-direction notes not carried forward
items.rule: Migrate deterministic reviewed head observations only when no later reviewed head record exists; unknown remains unknown.
tests: Starter Pass head observations migrate into split head perspective

items.finding: Assistant-reviewed starter data can look owner-verified
items.rule: Review authority and owner acceptance are separate visible metadata.
tests: Starter references visibly retain assistant review authority and pending owner acceptance
New owner verification creates owner-approved reference authority

items.finding: Unknown profile direction can become image-left
items.rule: PROFILE with unknown heading maps to legacy unknown, not left/right.
tests: Unknown profile heading never invents image-left

items.finding: Knowledge context mappings incomplete for subgroups
tests: All visible anatomical subgroups receive specific knowledge suggestions

items.rule: Save canonical needs_new_artwork; accept legacy new_piece on import/action.
tests: Legacy new_piece classification is normalized to needs_new_artwork

items.finding: View-conflict test contradicted its name due result slicing
tests: Confirmed view mismatch is surfaced, not automatically rejected anatomy

items.finding: Backup compatibility fixture not reviewer-portable / PASS timing weak
items.rule: Use package-local fixture and write PASS after assertions.

qualification: A later attempt to rerun the broader browser workflow stalled in the unchanged real CPU detector phase. Historical CP02 broad results are preserved separately and are not represented as a CP02.1 rerun.
